In the United States, a SWAT (special weapons and tactics) team is generic term for a law enforcement unit that uses specialized or military equipment and tactics. Although they were first created in the 1960s to handle riot control or violent confrontations with criminals, the number and usage of SWAT teams increased in the 1980s and 1990s during the War on Drugs and later in the aftermath of the September 11 attacks. In the United States as of 2005, SWAT teams were deployed 50,000 times every year, almost 80% of the time to serve search warrants, most often for narcotics.

results.name: Monastery of Batalha
results.description:
Monastery of Batalha in Portugal or [Santa Maria da Vitória na Batalha](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Batalha,_Portugal) was created to honor Virgin Mary for the victory of the Portuguese over the Castillian crown. 

After the death of Ferdinand I (1383), there was a succession war between Ferdinand's daughter Beatrice, queen of Castile and Ferdinand's half brother, John I. The battle of Aljubarrota was the decisive moment which marked the victory of John, the founding of the Aviz dynasty (1385-1580) and the beginning of military alliance between England and Portugal. This alliance is still active today (800 years old) and was used during the second world war.

The battle was also an important mark in the 100 years war. It was one of the many losses the French suffered. A trend that was changed later by Jeanne d'Arc. 

![](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/4/44/Batalha_monastery.jpg)

results.name: Castle of Consuegra (Toledo, Spain)
results.description:
Consuegra Castle is a fortress of Islamic origin located in the town of Consuegra, the ancient Roman city
of Consabura. It passed into Christian hands around the year 1090, but
after the battle of Consuegra it was recovered by Islamic troops.
In the 12th century it was finally conquered by Christian troops. For
its better defense, King Alfonso VIII donated the castle in 1183 to
the Military Order of Saint John of Jerusalem, which made it its main
fortress in the region. During the Peninsular War (1808–1814) it was
occupied by French troops who partially destroyed it in their retreat.

Currently the castle is owned by the Consuegra City Council, being one
of the most visited monuments in Castilla-La Mancha.

Model created in Reality Capture from 16,071 images and 192 laser scans

To know more: Molero García, J. (2011): “De encomienda a priorato. El
ascenso político de Consuegra en el mapa administrativo de la Orden de
San Juan (siglos XII-XV)”. In Consuegra en la historia, pp. 257-288.

results.name: Animated Mech - Marceline Sentinel Armor (Marcy)
results.description:
The Marceline Sentinel Armour, or better known as a Marcy, is a prototype military exosuit that is used on one-way-ticket missions as a last-ditch-effort, where the pilot’s body (who would otherwise be out of commission from injuries) is infused with the armour and becomes one with it. Marcies are brutal, but good at their job. None have returned from duty to date.

The mech has been modelled in both Zbrush and Maya, and then has been taken into Substance Painter for baking and texturing using a PBR pipeline workflow. The mesh was then rigged and animated in 3DS Max.

results.name: Hazmat Suit 3
results.description:
I made a hazmat suit model! Tried to get it accurate to real life while still looking good.

The creation phase of this model, from the cloth simulations to the texturing is all taking inspiration and trying to emulate the masterful work of the BigMediumSmall team and their "Hazmat USMON" character. My goal with this model was to create a free alternative for people to use that could rival the models like this that are in the market right now.

The suit itself is based off the AlphaTec® LIGHT Type CV/VP1 gas suit

The SCBA mask is based off the Spiromatic 90U S-Mask First Breath


Credits:

The human head was created with Makehuman

The hardhat model was created by Kristiyan Marinov and edited to fit inside the suit

results.name: Ehrengrab Johannes Benk
results.description:
Grave of honour of Johannes Benk at the Vienna Central Cemetery.
The Austrian sculptor Johannes Benk (1844-1914) created several statues for the Vienna Votivkirche, the Museum of Military History and the Museum of Art and Natural History. His main work, the Deutschmeister monument, is located on Vienna's Ringstrasse. In 1924 Benkgasse in Vienna was named after the sculptor.

results.name: Pick-up Truck Improvised Fighting Vehicle
results.description:
I made this truck by combining parts of scanned modes and then baking both texture and geometry data onto a low poly mesh. Most of the process was done using Blender with minor texture changes done in Substance Painter.</br>
I used the folllowing models:</br>
[Toyota Pickup truck by alban CC-BY](https://skfb.ly/6TYYA) </br>
[Chevy Impala Undercarriage by omegadarling CC-BY](https://skfb.ly/6xpIS) </br>
[Moldering Minivan (Free Raw Scan) by Renafox CC-BY](https://skfb.ly/o6Tyz) </br>
It's pretty interesting workflow that allows to quickly make fairly photorealistic models of objects that wouldn't be easy to find and scan in real life.</br>
Like this technical. Improvised military vehicle created by cutting off the roof of pickup truck and mounting in a machine gun in a cargo bed. Cars like this saw use in the Chadian–Libyan conflict that thanks to the wide use of converted Hiluxes and Land Cruisers was called "Toyota War''.
